note: First reading (22 texts). 20 patterns written, all provisional (wide). A seeded sample of each pattern's hits was read and given verdicts.

Sampling of round 1 read. 15 patterns corrected or split, 2 replaced the same day, 10 new patterns written from forms seen in the samples. Nine patterns made strict on the evidence of their samples. Frequent title lines that name no one added to a stoplist. Texts that the corpus taggers marked broken, refusal or off-topic are left out of the counts, with empty texts and texts that fail a word check.

Read 12 covered texts whole (recall check) and 20 uncovered texts from the ten models with the lowest coverage. Eleven new patterns from the forms that were missed: names in quotation marks, titles that recur in the body, lower-case kinds named by what they do. Five of them strict. Joining words 'to' and 'from' removed from capitalised names. A sentence that uses the word 'name' is now collected.

The two classes of patterns were replaced by a number: each pattern has a precision measured on read hits, each name in a text a score. Texts with no name are now tracked (a page of their own). Remaining patterns read to 20 hits or more. Recall check 3: 20 texts drawn from all texts, read whole. No new patterns.
